actual: PR CI deterministically deadlocks during pytest collection: backend/routers/health.py calls subprocess.run(..., capture_output=True) at module import while coverage tracing is active. The subprocess pipe reader threads wait on the Python import lock and the importing main thread waits in communicate(), so validation_center_backend never starts tests and only exits at the CI timeout. Fix must preserve exact runtime identity semantics, avoid import-time threaded pipe capture deadlock, add direct regression coverage, and must not weaken fail-closed identity evidence.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
